content: Spouses married under legal community property, separated by Sanremo Court judgment 102/2012 (final 2009). Husband sought division of marital home in Ventimiglia and movable antiques, plus compensation for wife's exclusive occupation from presidential measures date. Wife appeared contesting, raising nullity/non-existence objections regarding summons service in Switzerland, objecting marital home inadmissible (assigned to husband in separation), counterclaiming inclusion of wife's French properties, insurance policies, maintenance debt offsets. Articles 140, 142(3), 167(2), 191, 194, 720, 1116, 1148 Italian Code of Civil Procedure and Civil Code govern foreign service, late filing forfeitures, community dissolution, division rules, indivisible property sale. Issues concerned service validity to Swiss residence, late defense consequences, asset inclusion criteria, compensation commencement timing. Hague Convention 1965 service via Consular Authority valid: certificate performs Article 148 notification report function, provides full proof until proven false. Wife's Swiss residence established; service at residence correct—recipient's burden to arrange mail notification during absences. Wife's constitution remedied any nullity and achieved act's purpose. Original notification filing certified by registrar fulfilling plaintiff's obligations; photocopy with postal receipt in file. Defendant's November 2013 appearance (post-twenty-day deadline) forfeited counterclaim and strict-sense objection rights—Article 167(2) forfeiture absolute, mandatory, ex officio detectable. Counterclaim for asset reimbursement and other claims inadmissible as untimely. Separation finalized March 2011 dissolved community; transformation to ordinary joint ownership permits division per Articles 713 et seq. via Article 1116. Marital home in Ventimiglia and Limone Piemonte property subject to division. Wife's French properties personal assets acquired by donation/inheritance from relatives—Article 179 personal property exceptions exclude from community. Fruits (rental income) could fall within residual community but insignificant amounts; separation ruling denying wife maintenance considered income her support source implying consumption. Movable income (€5,183 in 2008) presumed consumed pre-2012 separation—burden of proving existence/non-consumption unmet. Compensation for occupation: Article 1148 establishes commencement from division filing date (2015) as moment restitution debt arises for good faith possessor, not separation finalization. Husband entitled €10,110 plus interest for 2015-2017 occupation. Movable property (furniture) divided per expert report: plaintiff possesses assets worth €29,500; total joint property €133,500; each entitled €66,750; husband receives additional €37,250 as equivalent value to equalize shares. 1999 note insufficient for consensual separation—no division agreement validity. Property assignment: Ventimiglia property to husband (€308,500), Limone property to wife (€240,700). Condominium fees: husband creditor €4,250.12 for advanced payments, deducted from wife's adjustment. Final adjustment: wife owes husband €30,650.24 plus interest after revaluation and interest calculations. Costs compensated 50% given dispute nature; remaining 75% borne by wife given partial defeat and inadmissible claims prolonging proceedings.
